description.narrative: JSC National Company Kazakhstan Temir Zholy (KTZ or the Company), a wholly owned subsidiary of the JSC Sovereign Wealth Fund Samruk-Kazyna (SK), is a fully integrated holding company that owns and operates the railway infrastructure and manages the provision of both freight and passenger transportation services in Kazakhstan. The total proposed investment is US$304 million loan package (denominated in CHF) with a maturity of 10 years. This package comprises (i) up to US$50 million IFC A loan, and (ii) the mobilization of up to US$254 million from other lenders. The proceeds will be used to finance the construction of the Almaty Railway Bypass a 130 km electrified railway line designed to bypass the logistics bottleneck along the Middle Corridor around Almaty (the Project).

The Project will increase rail track capacity to address constraints in Almatys railway infrastructure and enable KTZ to accommodate growing long-haul freight traffic. At the market level, the Project contributes to increasing resilience of freight transport and enables better connectivity to support the consolidation of the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route (Middle Corridor)

name.narrative: The proposed 130km railway line will be constructed in south-eastern Kazakhstan, near Almaty, the largest city in the country. Situated along the Middle Corridor, this line aims to bypass existing logistics bottlenecks in Almaty, facilitating more efficient transportation of transit and other cargo.
